concerns.text: No task verifies that each dataset’s outcome column is explicitly documented and recorded in `data/processed/dataset_metadata.json` as required by FR-005.
The specification mandates validation of every raw dataset against `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml` (FR-009), but there is no task that performs this schema validation.
FR-017 requires generation and validation of `data/processed/dataset_metadata.json`; no task creates or validates this metadata file.

SC-001 demands a verification step that each dataset’s output includes `p_value_delta`, `direction`, `ci_overlap`, and `effect_size_change`; no task asserts the presence and correctness of these fields.
SC-002 requires all numeric metrics to have ≥ 3‑decimal precision, yet no task checks or enforces this precision across generated JSON artefacts.
Task T074a (generation of MCAR and MAR missingness mechanisms) remains undone, leaving FR-006’s missingness‑mechanism generation uncovered.
Task T051 references a non‑existent success criterion identifier `SC-03` (the correct ID is `SC-003`), indicating a stale tag.
